topic.title: Official replay viewer is currently unreachable

messages.content:
Hi organizers, The official replay viewer at https://ptcgvis.heroz.jp/ appears to be unreachable. As of August 3, 2026, around 07:08 UTC (16:08 JST):

  • The hostname resolves normally to 54.199.209.208.
  • TCP connections to both ports 80 and 443 time out before an HTTP response or TLS handshake is established.
  • The problem affects both the base URL and individual replay URLs.
  • Kaggle itself and the Kaggle Episode Replay API remain accessible.
  • External TCP checks from multiple locations, including Tokyo, Hong Kong, and Singapore, also time out.

External connectivity check: https://check-host.net/check-report/464023adk33

Could you please confirm whether the replay viewer is currently under maintenance or experiencing an outage? If this is unintentional, could you investigate the viewer server or its network configuration? Thank you.
